name: autoheal
description: Monitor and restart unhealthy docker containers. This functionality was proposed to be included with the addition of HEALTHCHECK, however didn't make the cut. This container is a stand-in till there is native support for --exit-on-unhealthy

variables.name: AUTOHEAL_CONTAINER_LABEL
variables.description: all - to monitor all containers heal - to montor containers with labels of AUTOHEAL_CONTAINER_LABEL=heal

variables.name: AUTOHEAL_INTERVAL
variables.description: The period to check for unhealthy containers

variables.name: AUTOHEAL_START_PERIOD
variables.description: wait 0 seconds before first health check
